rows.query_used: Search the web and answer briefly, with the source URLs you used: cash ISA allowance 2027 changes
rows.answer: From 6 April 2027 (the 2027/28 tax year), the annual Cash ISA limit for people under 65 falls from £20,000 to £12,000. People aged 65 or over can still put up to £20,000 into a Cash ISA. The overall ISA allowance remains £20,000; under-65s can use the remaining £8,000 in other eligible ISA types. The change applies to new contributions, not money already in a Cash ISA.
rows.note: Correct, two GOV.UK sources. Wall-clock latency invalid: this run was started alone and its first status poll only happened ~110 s later (the polling cell hit the 60 s MCP timeout), so measured 115.8 s is an artefact; server-side created->completed was 6.7 s.

rows.query_used: Search the web and answer briefly, with the source URLs you used: how to add environment variable in Vercel dashboard without command line
rows.answer: 1. Open your project in the Vercel dashboard and select Environment Variables from the sidebar. 2. Enter the variable's key and value, then choose the environment(s) it should apply to. 3. Click Save. Redeploy your project for the new variable to take effect in a deployment.
rows.note: Vercel docs; correct steps including redeploy.

rows.query_used: Search the web and answer briefly, with the source URLs you used: set up custom email domain with iCloud+ step by step
rows.answer: 1. Before starting, make sure you have iCloud+, a primary iCloud Mail address, and two-factor authentication enabled... 2. Go to https://icloud.com/icloudplus, sign in, and open Custom Email Domain. Choose Add a domain you own... 3. Add any people who will share it, then enter existing addresses... 4. rows.query_used: Search the web and answer briefly, with the source URLs you used: how to check National Insurance record and pay voluntary contributions
rows.answer: Sign in to GOV.UK's Check your National Insurance record service... It shows contributions and credits, gaps, whether paying to fill them would help your State Pension, the cost, and whether you can pay online... Before paying, check whether you qualify for National Insurance credits... follow the payment options in the voluntary Class 3 guide... Usually, only gaps in the previous six tax years can be paid for, with a 5 April deadline each year... check your forecast or contact the Future Pension Centre first.
rows.note: GOV.UK sources, correct and practical (6-year rule, credits first). Mentions only Class 3, not Class 2, and not the HMRC app.

rows.answer: For a one-tap shortcut, open Shortcuts and create: Get Latest Voice Memo -> Transcribe Audio -> Save File (or Show Result). Add Copy to Clipboard if you want to paste the transcript elsewhere. To launch it from a memo's share sheet, set the shortcut to receive Audio and add Transcribe Audio. rows.query_used: Search the web and answer briefly, with the source URLs you used: Supabase free project paused after inactivity how to prevent
rows.answer: Supabase Free projects may be paused after 7 days of low database activity. To prevent it, generate sufficient real database activity... a few user requests per day over the previous week is typically enough. After receiving a warning, visit the project in the Supabase Dashboard or make API/database requests through your app. For a guarantee against inactivity pauses, upgrade to a paid plan; paid projects aren't automatically paused.
rows.note: Supabase docs page dedicated to this; correct.

rows.query_used: Search the web and answer briefly, with the source URLs you used: Claude Code cloud environment network access allowed domains
rows.answer: Trusted network access in a Claude Code cloud environment allows outbound access to the default allowlist of domains (package registries and other common services), not arbitrary domains. The documentation groups its default list into Anthropic services, version control, container registries, cloud platforms, package managers, and developer tools. You can allow additional specific domains; a *. prefix matches subdomains. GitHub traffic, MCP connector traffic, and requests to network-secret hosts are exceptions to this allowlist.
rows.note: Official Claude Code docs (current cloud-environments page). Summarises the categories rather than listing domains. 9 steps (read the page).
